title: analytics: the native strategy answers DATABASE_ERROR / 500 for a declared dotted path to a column the related object lacks
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28258 dev (PR #28553, os-dev-report `6554100004` on #28258), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

Reach: `queryDataset`, native strategy, measured. A declared path to a column the related object does not have (`account.bogus` with `include: account`): native answers `DATABASE_ERROR` / 500; ObjectQL answers `INVALID_FIELD` / 400; the draft preview answers one `null` group.

Business reason: an author's typo in a dataset dimension reaches the database and comes back as a server error, logged as a 500, instead of a field refusal that names the bad member.

## Wanted

The native strategy refuses the member before SQL with the same 400 the ObjectQL face answers.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `DATABASE_ERROR dotted dimension` (13 hits): none open on this path. **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, the dataset compiler and the draft preview path).

Links back: #28258, PR #28553, #28201 (the preview undeclared-dimension precedent, closed)
